notes.title: Update on the Release of "The Concentration of Lust"
notes.notes:
Hello dear friends,

I have some important news regarding the release of "The Concentration of Lust." 
While the game is 99% ready, I have encountered a delicate issue with the artist that requires a bit more time to resolve. This unexpected challenge has unfortunately delayed my initial release date.

I apologize for this delay and I'm working diligently to ensure that I deliver the highest quality experience possible.

In the meantime, I ask you to stay tuned and add "The Concentration of Lust" to your wishlist to be the first to know about the game's release. The game is coming soon!

In addition, I want to say that the game will have a significant discount in the first week after release. I'm confident it will be worth the wait and can't wait for you to experience the final product.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

Cheers,
Meepower
